svg.title: Fitting a straight zipper into a round opening
svg.desc: Left: the rim seen from above as a circle of 48 stitches, 12 inches around. Right: the rim pinched flat into a straight opening 6 inches long, half the circumference, with front and back edges meeting. A 5 inch zipper sits along it, leaving about half an inch at each end, which is closed with a few whipstitches joining front to back. The zipper tape sits behind the crochet with the teeth just below the edge.
svg.text: A round rim, pinched flat, is half its circumference long
Sew the tape behind the crochet, teeth just below the top edge.
Zipper length: up to half the rim, ideally a little less.
